newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Eight dead in Ho Chi Minh City restaurant blaze.
newsitem.headline: Eight dead in Ho Chi Minh City restaurant blaze.

text.p: Police in southern Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City are investigating a late-night restaurant fire in which at least eight people were killed and a number of others seriously injured.
An official in the southern city told Reuters on Friday fire services were alerted to the blaze at the multi-storey Sunset Restaurant in central Ho Chi Minh City around 3.00 a.m. on Thursday.
Local newspaper reports said the fire swept through the restaurant with little warning, trapping people in upper floors.
Fire-fighters had to break through locked doors to reach victims. Four people jumped from upper storeys of the building to escape the inferno.
Among the victims was the restaurant owner, his wife and their four-year-old son.
The official was unable to provide details but said six people were seriously hurt and the final death toll was expected to be higher.
